label: SIMULASI LATIHAN — range mengikuti CVE-2026-40519 (Nginx Proxy Manager authenticated RCE via setupCertbotPlugins). Jangan mengeksploitasi; latihan hanya identifikasi, triase dan patch.
prerequisite_definition: Aplikasi Nginx Proxy Manager terpasang di workload dan versinya diamati operator dari /app/package.json; bukan asumsi akses login atau izin certificates:manage.
range_semantics: affected_from inclusive; fixed exclusive affected/inclusive patched. Row without series covers all minor series between the bounds (sumber: introduced 2.9.14, last_affected 2.15.1, rilis pertama sesudahnya 2.16.0). Versi sebelum 2.9.14 not_affected untuk advisory ini. Rules only belong to this simulation.
prerequisites: Reconcile runtime image identity, observed timestamp and source with runtime SBOM before status
No exploitation, no login with default credentials, no vulnerability scanning
mitigation_policy: Underlying affected; verified=true, control evidence, owner, matching workload/advisory/image, verified_at <= as_of < expires_at.

triage.exposure: proxy workload publishes storefront 8080 and admin UI/API 81 (lab port 19184)
triage.blackout: not yet assigned; confirm the actual peak window before drafting a patch plan
triage.criticality: proxy high when admin UI is reachable
